name: eukaryotic translation initiation factor 1A X-linked

function.text: EIF1AX encodes eukaryotic translation initiation factor 1A, X-chromosomal. Annotated molecular activities include translation initiation factor activity and translation factor activity, RNA binding. It participates in ribosome assembly and translational initiation.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Uveal melanoma; Pulmonary carcinoid tumor; Follicular thyroid carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: EIF1AX encodes eukaryotic translation initiation factor 1A, X-chromosomal. It forms part of the 43S pre-initiation complex (43S PIC), which binds to the mRNA cap-proximal region, scans mRNA 5'-untranslated region, and locates the initiation codon. This protein enhances formation of the cap-proximal complex. It is released after 80S initiation complex formation, just after GTP hydrolysis by EIF5B, and before release of EIF5B.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EIF1AX have been reported in uveal melanoma, pulmonary carcinoid tumor, and follicular thyroid carcinoma.
